# before-first-release — operator notes

## Goal

Strip template sample product and unused test/support files before first publish.

## Fast audit (PowerShell)

```powershell
# Sample converter leftovers
rg -n "pnlToXml|xmlToPnl|PnlXmlConverter|winccoa-pnl-xml|PNL.?XML" src test package.json README.md

# Helper / fixture usage
rg -n "test-project-helpers|fixtures/" test src scripts

# Orphan helpers: open test/helpers and confirm each file is imported
Get-ChildItem test/helpers -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem test/fixtures -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```

## Delete pattern (from install-info lesson)

- Unused `test/helpers/test-project-helpers.ts` and fixture trees with no readers → delete
- Do not keep empty helper folders “for later”
- CI must not reference removed OAPROJ/fixture paths

## After cleanup

```powershell
npm run style-fix
npm test
```

Open PR → `develop` (squash). Then continue with first-release skill.
